decisions.description: To decide whether case is to be auto approved

rules.name: AutoApprovalDecision_AutoApprovalOutcome
rules.conditionLogic: (5 AND 12 AND 4) OR (6 AND 13 AND 4) OR (10 AND 11 AND 1 AND 4) OR ((7 OR 8) AND 2 AND 4) OR (9 AND 3 AND 4)
rules.label: Auto Approval Outcome

decisions.description: Decision to check the level of approval the triggering case has gone through
decisions.name: CaseApprovalStatusDecision
decisions.label: Case Approval Status Decision

rules.name: CaseApprovalStatusDecision_FirstLevelApprovalOutcome
rules.conditionLogic: (4 AND 1 AND 2) OR (5 AND 3 AND 1 AND 2) OR (1 AND 2 AND 6)
rules.label: First Level Approval Outcome

rules.name: CaseApprovalStatusDecision_FinalApprovalOutcome
rules.conditionLogic: ((5 AND 4 AND 1 AND 2) OR (5 AND 3 AND 1 AND 2 ) OR (6 AND 4 AND 1 AND 2) OR (6 AND 3 AND 1 AND 2) OR (4 AND 1 AND 2) OR (6 AND 4 AND 1 AND 2) OR (1 AND 2 AND 3)) AND(7 OR 8 OR 9 OR 10 OR 11 OR 12)
rules.label: Final Approval Outcome

decisions.description: Decision to check if Case has gone through final level of approval.
decisions.name: CheckApproverFinalLevelDecision
decisions.label: Check Approver Final Level Decision
decisions.defaultConnectorLabel: Final Level Customer Service Leadership Queue

rules.name: CheckApproverFinalLevelDecision_FinalLevelProductManagementQueueOutcome
rules.label: Final Level Product Management Queue Outcome

rules.name: CheckApproverFinalLevelDecision_FinalLevelProductManagementLeadershipQueue
rules.label: Final Level Product Management Leadership Queue

rules.name: CheckApproverFinalLevelDecision_FinalLevelManagerOutcome
rules.conditionLogic: ((1 AND 18 AND 19 AND 12 AND (13 OR 14 OR 15)) OR (2 AND 20 AND 21 AND 12 AND (13 OR 14 OR 15)) OR ((3 OR 4) AND 8 AND 9 AND 12 AND (13 OR 14 OR 15)) OR (5 AND 10 AND 11 AND 12 AND (13 OR 14 OR 15)) OR (16 AND 17 AND 6 AND 7 AND 12 AND (13 OR 14 OR 15)))
rules.label: Final Level Manager Outcome

rules.name: CheckApproverFinalLevelDecision_FinalLevelAccountManagerOutcome
rules.conditionLogic: ((1 AND 15 AND 9 AND (10 OR 11 OR 12)) OR (2 AND 16 AND 9 AND (10 OR 11 OR 12)) OR ((3 OR 4) AND 7 AND 9 AND (10 OR 11 OR 12)) OR (5 AND 8 AND 9 AND (10 OR 11 OR 12)) OR (13 AND 14 AND 6 AND 9 AND (10 OR 11 OR 12)))
rules.label: Final Level Account Manager Outcome

rules.name: CheckApproverFinalLevelDecision_FinalLevelSupplyChainOutcome
rules.conditionLogic: ((1 AND 18 AND 9 AND (10 OR 11 OR 12 OR 13 OR (14 AND 15))) OR (2 AND 19 AND 9 AND (10 OR 11 OR 12 OR 13 OR (14 AND 15))) OR ((3 OR 4) AND 7 AND 9 AND (10 OR 11 OR 12 OR 13 OR (14 AND 15))) OR (5 AND 8 AND 9 AND (10 OR 11 OR 12 OR 13 OR (14 AND 15))) OR (16 AND 17 AND 6 AND 9 AND (10 OR 11 OR 12 OR 13 OR (14 AND 15))))
rules.label: Final Level Supply Chain Outcome

rules.name: CheckApproverFinalLevelDecision_FinalLevelProductManagementAndQualityOutcome
rules.conditionLogic: (1 AND 14 AND 9 AND 10 AND 11) OR (2 AND 15 AND 9 AND 10 AND 11) OR ((3 OR 4) AND 7 AND 9 AND 10 AND 11) OR (5 AND 8 AND 9 AND 10 AND 11) OR (12 AND 13 AND 6 AND 9 AND 10 AND 11)
rules.label: Final Level Product Management And Quality Outcome

rules.name: CheckApproverFinalLevelDecision_FinalLevelServiceOutcome
rules.conditionLogic: ((1 AND 13 AND 9 AND 10) OR (2 AND 14 AND 9 AND 10) OR ((3 OR 4) AND 7 AND 9 AND 10) OR (5 AND 8 AND 9 AND 10) OR (11 AND 12 AND 6 AND 9 AND 10))
rules.label: Final Level Service Outcome

rules.name: CheckApproverFinalLevelDecision_FinalLevelQualityOutcome
rules.conditionLogic: ((1 AND 13 AND 9 AND 10) OR (2 AND 14 AND 9 AND 10) OR ((3 OR 4) AND 7 AND 9 AND 10) OR (5 AND 8 AND 9 AND 10) OR (11 AND 12 AND 6 AND 9 AND 10))
rules.label: Final Level Quality Outcome

decisions.description: Decision to check the Approver for case's first level approval
decisions.name: CheckApproverFirstLevelDecision
decisions.label: Check Approver First Level Decision

rules.name: CheckApproverFirstLevelDecision_ManagerOutcome
rules.conditionLogic: ( (1 AND 19 AND 20 AND 12 AND (13 OR 14 OR 15)) OR (2 AND 21 AND 22 AND 12 AND (13 OR 14 OR 15)) OR ((3 OR 4) AND 8 AND 9 AND 12 AND (13 OR 14 OR 15)) OR (5 AND 10 AND 11 AND 12 AND (13 OR 14 OR 15)) OR (17 AND 18 AND 6 AND 7 AND 12 AND (13 OR 14 OR 15)) ) AND 16
rules.label: Manager Outcome

rules.name: CheckApproverFirstLevelDecision_AccountManagerOutcome
rules.conditionLogic: ((1 AND 16 AND 9 AND (10 OR 11 OR 12)) OR (2 AND 17 AND 9 AND (10 OR 11 OR 12)) OR ((3 OR 4) AND 7 AND 9 AND (10 OR 11 OR 12)) OR (5 AND 8 AND 9 AND (10 OR 11 OR 12)) OR (14 AND 15 AND 6 AND 9 AND (10 OR 11 OR 12))) AND 13
rules.label: Account Manager Outcome

rules.name: CheckApproverFirstLevelDecision_SupplyChainOutcome
rules.conditionLogic: ((1 AND 19 AND 9 AND (10 OR 11 OR 12 OR 13 OR (15 AND 16))) OR (2 AND 20 AND 9 AND (10 OR 11 OR 12 OR 13 OR (15 AND 16))) OR ((3 OR 4) AND 7 AND 9 AND (10 OR 11 OR 12 OR 13 OR (15 AND 16))) OR (5 AND 8 AND 9 AND (10 OR 11 OR 12 OR 13 OR (15 AND 16))) OR (17 AND 18 AND 6 AND 9 AND (10 OR 11 OR 12 OR 13 OR (15 AND 16)))) AND 14
rules.label: Supply Chain Outcome

rules.name: CheckApproverFirstLevelDecision_ProductManagementandQualityOutcome
rules.conditionLogic: ((1 AND 15 AND 9 AND 10) OR(2 AND 16 AND 9 AND 10) OR (13 AND 14 AND 6 AND 9 AND 10) OR ((3 OR 4) AND 7 AND 9 AND 10) OR (5 AND 8 AND 9 AND 10)) AND 11 AND 12
rules.label: Product Management and Quality Outcome

rules.name: CheckApproverFirstLevelDecision_ServiceOutcome
rules.conditionLogic: ((1 AND 14 AND 9 AND 10) OR (2 AND 15 AND 9 AND 10) OR ((3 OR 4) AND 7 AND 9 AND 10) OR (5 AND 8 AND 9 AND 10) OR (12 AND 13 AND 6 AND 9 AND 10)) AND 11
rules.label: Service Outcome

rules.name: CheckApproverFirstLevelDecision_QualityOutcome
rules.conditionLogic: ((1 AND 14 AND 9 AND 10) OR (2 AND 15 AND 9 AND 10) OR ((3 OR 4) AND 7 AND 9 AND 10) OR (5 AND 8 AND 9 AND 10) OR (12 AND 13 AND 6 AND 9 AND 10)) AND 11
rules.label: Quality Outcome
